title: Design System: 爆点实验室创作工作台

display.purpose: Compact page names; never a giant promotional headline inside tools.

headline.purpose: Concept names and authored titles inside proof or media areas.

title.purpose: Module, panel and workflow step headings.

body.purpose: Task inputs, explanations and actionable feedback.

label.purpose: Field names, timestamps, states and secondary actions.

data.purpose: Points, costs, durations, balances and account metrics.

shadows.name: workbench-panel
shadows.purpose: Low electric lift for the shared blue workbench panels.

shadows.name: graphite-panel
shadows.purpose: Structural lift for AI director, market monitor and media tools.

shadows.name: menu-lift
shadows.purpose: Temporary lift for account menus and pickers.

shadows.name: primary-action
shadows.purpose: Restrained magenta lift under the sole primary action.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Hover, selection and disclosure state changes.

motion.name: primary-hover
motion.purpose: One-pixel lift for the active primary action; pressed returns to rest.

motion.name: media-change
motion.purpose: Subtle opacity and scale correction when a preview changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes non-essential transforms and preview transitions.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The sole high-emphasis action for the current workflow step.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: #ff4d8d; color: #190b11; cursor: pointer; font: 800 15px/1.2 "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(255,77,141,.18); transition: background .2s ease-out, transform .2s ease-out; } .ds-primary svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; color: #f4c95d; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #ff659e; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #59d9e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A quiet bordered action for retry, back, download or supporting work.
components.css: .ds-secondary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; border: 1px solid #34468c; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #f6f3ef; cursor: pointer; font: 700 11px/1.2 "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color .2s ease-out, background .2s ease-out; } .ds-secondary svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; } .ds-secondary:hover { border-color: #59d9e8; background: rgba(89,217,232,.05); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #59d9e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workbench Field
components.description: The standard labeled field for task facts and merchant inputs.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; color: #b2bce8; font: 700 11px/1.4 "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: 7px; } .ds-field textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 76px; padding: 11px 12px; resize: vertical; border: 1px solid #34468c; border-radius: 10px; outline: 0; background: #101738; color: #f6f3ef; font: 400 13px/1.55 "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field textarea:hover { border-color: #536bd0; } .ds-field textarea:focus { border-color: #59d9e8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(89,217,232,.14); } .ds-field textarea:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #59d9e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Tabs
components.description: A compact two-or-more option switch for history, media and workflow views.
components.css: .ds-tabs { padding: 4px; display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(118px,1fr)); gap: 4px; border-radius: 11px; background: #101738; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tabs button { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #b2bce8; cursor: pointer; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-tabs button span { margin-left: 5px; font-size: 9px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tabs button:hover { color: #f6f3ef; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { background: #1d285e; color: #f6f3ef; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px #ff4d8d; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #59d9e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Creation Mode Card
components.description: A tall, quiet entry card that names one creation mode and its single launch action.
components.html: AI成片
components.css: .ds-mode { width: 250px; min-height: 300px; padding: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border: 1px solid #34468c; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(25,35,86,.96),rgba(18,25,65,.96)); color: #f6f3ef; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(2,5,29,.22); } .ds-mode-icon { width: 60px; height: 60px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #24326d; color: #59d9e8; } .ds-mode-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; } .ds-mode h3 { margin: 18px 0; font-size: 24px; } .ds-mode button { width: 100%; height: 48px; margin-top: auto; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #ff4d8d; color: #190b11; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 800; } .ds-mode button:hover { background: #ff659e; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-mode button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #59d9e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workbench Navigation
components.description: The deep-blue shared shell navigation with one quiet magenta active state.
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 188px; padding: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; background: linear-gradient(180deg,#151e55,#10173d 62%,#16113f); font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav button { width: 100%; height: 45px; padding: 0 13px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #aeb9ec; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-align: left; } .ds-nav svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-nav button:hover { background: #22316d; color: #f6f3ef; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active { background: linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(255,77,141,.24),rgba(116,67,217,.22)); color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #b15292, inset 3px 0 #ff4d8d; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active svg { color: #ff4d8d; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #59d9e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workflow Steps
components.description: A continuous status rail for multi-step AI creation flows.
components.html: 1上传素材2锁定口播3AI成片
components.css: .ds-steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #34468c; border-radius: 12px; background: #151d49; color: #777c9b; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-steps span { min-height: 62px; padding: 0 15px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; border-right: 1px solid #34468c; } .ds-steps span:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-steps i { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #536bd0; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 10px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 900; } .ds-steps b { font-size: 12px; } .ds-steps .ds-complete { color: #59d9e8; } .ds-steps .ds-complete i { background: rgba(89,217,232,.1); } .ds-steps .ds-active { background: rgba(255,77,141,.07); color: #f6f3ef; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px #ff4d8d; } .ds-steps .ds-active i { border-color: #ff4d8d; background: #ff4d8d; color: #190b11; }

components.name: Account Record Row
components.description: A flat, auditable ledger row for daily consumption and recharge history.
components.html:
AI 商家素材成片12:55 · viral_1786…swpf6
-28 PTS余额 8,299
components.css: .ds-record { min-height: 72px; padding: 13px 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto minmax(110px,auto); gap: 22px; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid #34468c; color: #f6f3ef; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-record div { min-width: 0; } .ds-record div b { display: block; overflow: hidden; font-size: 12px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-record div span { margin-top: 5px; display: block; overflow: hidden; color: #b2bce8; font-size: 9px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-record strong { color: #f4c95d; font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-record small { color: #b2bce8; font-size: 9px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Media Preview
components.description: A poster-first, low-radius media frame that preserves the source ratio and keeps playback and download distinct.
components.css: .ds-media { width: 260px; margin: 0; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #34468c; border-radius: 16px; background: #151d49; color: #f6f3ef; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(2,5,29,.22); } .ds-media-frame { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 9/16; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 7px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 60% 28%,#34468c,#121419 58%); } .ds-media-frame svg { width: 44px; height: 44px; color: #f6f3ef; } .ds-media figcaption { margin-top: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-media figcaption b { font-size: 13px; } .ds-media figcaption a { color: #59d9e8; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; text-decoration: none; } .ds-media figcaption a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-media figcaption a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #59d9e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Deferred Module Skeleton
components.description: A local loading surface that preserves the workbench shell while the selected feature loads on demand.
components.html: 正在打开视频创作
components.css: .ds-module-loading { min-height: 210px; padding: 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; border: 1px solid #34468c; border-radius: 16px; background: #151d49; color: #f6f3ef; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-module-loading > span { width: 32px; height: 32px; flex: 0 0 auto; border: 3px solid rgba(89,217,232,.2); border-top-color: #59d9e8; border-radius: 50%; animation: ds-spin .8s linear infinite; } .ds-module-loading div { width: min(420px,100%); } .ds-module-loading b { display: block; margin-bottom: 14px; font-size: 13px; } .ds-module-loading i { height: 8px; margin-top: 8px; display: block; border-radius: 7px; background: linear-gradient(90deg,#202c69,#34468c,#202c69); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: ds-shimmer 1.3s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-module-loading i:last-child { width: 68%; } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } @keyframes ds-shimmer { to { background-position: -200% 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-module-loading > span, .ds-module-loading i { animation: none; } }

narrative.northStar: The Electric Proofing Table / 电光打样台
narrative.overview:
爆点实验室把商家的图片、短视频、市场动态和会员资产组织成一张持续工作的数字打样台。深靛蓝是工作间的环境光，石墨黑是创作与预览的校样区域；品红、电子青和信号黄像三种功能明确的套准墨，只在选择、焦点、生成、成本与状态处出现。

系统不是娱乐化控制台。它强调真实内容、清楚步骤、可恢复进度和可核对账目：复杂的 AI 流程被拆成稳定面板、步骤状态、素材轨道和结果区；市场动态使用账号栏、资料区与视频网格；会员中心使用余额、分区流水和资产入口。每个模块可以有自己的任务构图，但必须共享相同的色彩语义、控件密度和反馈语言。

公开首页与会员工作台是两个明确分离的体验层。首页只承担品牌展示、登录与进入工作台，不预取会员、模板、支付或市场数据；工作台先交付稳定外壳，再在用户打开对应功能后加载代码与数据。性能不是隐藏的工程细节，而是本设计系统对“即时响应”的组成部分。
keyCharacteristics: 深靛蓝工作台外壳与石墨校样区域形成双层生产环境
品红表示主选择与生成，电子青表示焦点、校准与正向到账，信号黄表示成本、消费与提醒
面板、列表和步骤条优先承载任务状态，不用装饰性数据制造专业感
桌面端并排提高效率，移动端保持相同任务顺序并消除页面级横向溢出
图片、视频、账号、流水和生成结果都使用真实内容与明确空状态
首页轻量进入、工作台外壳先行、功能按需加载，避免在首屏初始化整套平台
视频先展示首帧封面，用户发起播放后再读取媒体数据

rules.name: The Three-Ink Rule
rules.body: 品红只表示选择或生成，电子青只表示焦点、完成或正向到账，信号黄只表示成本、消费或提醒；不要互换语义。

rules.name: The Two-Table Rule
rules.body: 深蓝承担产品外壳，石墨承担需要视觉后退的创作和媒体区域；同一面板内不要无理由混用两套底色。

rules.name: The Ink Is Rare Rule
rules.body: 功能墨色不铺满大型面板，也不叠加霓虹发光；大面积始终由深蓝或石墨中性色承担。

rules.name: The Operational Type Rule
rules.body: 字号服务于扫描、比较和操作；标题必须让位于素材、结果、账号数据和唯一主操作。

rules.name: The Workflow Order Rule
rules.body: 响应式可以改变列数、固定方式和轨道方向，但不能改变用户完成任务的顺序。

rules.name: The One Active Job Rule
rules.body: 一个页面只允许一个明确的当前步骤和一个高强调主操作；后台并行不转化为前台视觉噪音。

rules.name: The Instant Shell Rule
rules.body: 先显示可操作的页面骨架，再加载会员资产和功能模块；禁止为了“数据齐全”让用户面对空白首屏。

rules.name: The Media Before Bytes Rule
rules.body: 视频列表与结果区先使用首帧封面和固定画幅稳定布局，用户播放时才读取媒体；页面打开时不得批量读取完整视频。

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: 阴影只说明真实层级、悬停或固定状态；普通列表行和信息块保持平面。

rules.name: The Proof Sheet Rule
rules.body: 工具面板可以柔和，媒体与成品画幅必须更克制；用较小圆角区分“工具”与“内容”。

dos: Do 保持每个模块的任务顺序、当前步骤、预计成本和结果状态一眼可见。
Do 用深蓝外壳、石墨工作区、完整 1px 边框和少量结构阴影建立层级。
Do 让品红、电子青和信号黄持续承担固定语义，并保留可见键盘焦点。
Do 为加载、空数据、错误、重试、已完成和历史记录提供真实状态。
Do 在移动端重排而非缩小桌面布局，保证素材、视频、账号与流水可以完整阅读。
Do 使用真实商家素材、账号信息、任务流水和可核对的商业事实。
Do 让公开首页独立于工作台数据，并在工作台先交付外壳、后加载当前功能。
Do 为视频提供真实首帧封面、固定画幅、分段播放和独立下载动作。
donts: Don't 使用游戏控制台式 HUD、密集霓虹描边、装饰性遥测或无意义英文标签。
Don't 给每一条记录、每一个指标或每一个说明都套独立圆角卡片。
Don't 用厚重单侧彩边、异形缺角、渐变文字或硬偏移阴影制造“科技感”。
Don't 把主色互换语义，或让多个高强调按钮在同一当前步骤中竞争。
Don't 隐藏错误恢复、积分结算、生成状态或刷新后的草稿恢复状态。
Don't 强制裁切媒体、虚构账号数据或把 AI 合成场景冒充真实事实。
Don't 在工作台首屏同时初始化会员、模板、支付、市场动态和全部创作工具。
Don't 在页面打开时预载完整视频，或用空黑视频框代替可识别的首帧封面。
